blocks.source: ファイナルファンタジー5
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy V
Around 1993

blocks.source: 【質量・物語】
blocks.translation: [Content and Story]

blocks.source: 豊富な乗物によって、プレイヤーの行動範囲が広がる過程が自然。ご都合主義もあるが、テンポ良く話を進めるためなら許容範囲だと思う。
blocks.translation: The way the player's range of movement naturally expands through the abundance of vehicles is well done. There are some contrived developments, but I think they are acceptable if they help move the story along at a good pace.

blocks.source: ＦＦ５のストーリーは今ひとつという人も時々いるが、異議を唱えたい。
blocks.translation: Some people occasionally say that FFV's story is mediocre, but I have to disagree.

blocks.source: 確かに文章量は少ないし、キャラクターの掘り下げも少ないかもしれない。それでも、複数の世界に渡って繰り広げられるシナリオは壮大で、世界の合体というアイデアは斬新でありながら、きちんとゲームとして組み込まれている。また、魅力的な敵キャラの存在も話を盛り上げる。エンディングはラストバトルの結果（各キャラクターが戦闘不能かどうか？）によって、複数パターンに細かく分岐するというこだわりっぷり。
blocks.translation: The amount of text is certainly small, and the characters may not be explored in much depth. Even so, the scenario unfolding across multiple worlds is epic, and the idea of merging the worlds is fresh while being properly integrated into the game. The presence of fascinating enemies also adds excitement to the story. The ending is impressively divided into several distinct patterns depending on the outcome of the final battle (whether or not each character is incapacitated).

blocks.source: 何よりもテンポが良くて、シナリオがゲーム性の邪魔をしている部分がほとんど無い。
blocks.translation: Above all, the pacing is excellent, and there are almost no parts where the scenario gets in the way of the gameplay.

blocks.source: 例えば、ＦＦシリーズでは、シナリオの都合でキャラクターの入替が頻発する作品も少なく無い。この作品でも半ばで離脱するキャラが存在するが、能力は受け継がれるためゲーム部分の邪魔にはならない。むしろ、そのシーンを演出の一環として昇華している。
blocks.translation: For example, many games in the FF series frequently switch characters in and out for the sake of the scenario. This game also has a character who leaves partway through, but their abilities are passed on, so it does not interfere with the gameplay. Rather, the scene is elevated into part of the game's presentation.

blocks.source: 個人的には「ゲームシナリオとはこうあるべき」という理想形の１つだと思っている。
blocks.translation: Personally, I think this is one ideal example of what a game scenario should be.

blocks.source: 【システム・バランス】
blocks.translation: [Systems and Balance]

blocks.source: ４人いるキャラクターの能力には、ほとんど違いは無い。その代わりにジョブアビリティシステムが存在する。これは、ＪＲＰＧの成長システムにおける歴史的革命と言っても過言では無い。ＦＦ３と違ってジョブを変えても、以前のジョブで覚えたアビリティを使用することができるため、プレイヤーの趣向に応じて様々なプレイが可能となる。
blocks.translation: There is very little difference between the abilities of the four characters. In their place, there is a job ability system. It would not be an exaggeration to call this a historic revolution in JRPG progression systems. Unlike in FFIII, changing jobs does not prevent you from using abilities learned in previous jobs, allowing for a variety of playstyles according to the player's preferences.

blocks.source: ……と、これだけ書くと、ＤＱ３の転職等とそれ程違わないのだが、
blocks.translation: That said, if this were all I wrote, it would not be all that different from the job-changing system in DQIII, but...

blocks.source: ・個性的で豊富な２２種類にも及ぶジョブとそれに紐付くアビリティ。特に青魔道士やバーサーカーは斬新。
blocks.translation: ・Twenty-two distinctive and varied jobs, each with its own associated abilities. The Blue Mage and Berserker in particular are innovative.

blocks.source: ・ＡＰの導入によって、ジョブレベルとキャラクターレベルを切り離す。
blocks.translation: ・The introduction of AP separates job levels from character levels.

blocks.source: ・他ジョブのアビリティを１つだけ使用できる（すっぴんは２つ）という制約付け。
blocks.translation: ・The restriction that allows you to use only one ability from another job (two for the Freelancer).

blocks.source: 等々の絶妙な味付けによって、それまでのゲームシステムとは一線を画した物に仕上がっている。１９９２年の作品であるため、今見ると改善すべき点もあるかとは思うが、それでも今のＲＰＧでこれを超えたと言える程の成長システムがあるかどうかは疑わしい。考案した伊藤裕之氏の功績は素晴らしいものがある。
blocks.translation: These and other subtle touches make it something distinctly different from previous game systems. Since it was released in 1992, there may be points that should be improved when viewed today, but even so, it is questionable whether any modern RPG has a progression system that can truly be said to surpass it. Hiroyuki Ito, who devised it, deserves tremendous credit.

blocks.source: 以上の様に戦術の自由度が非常に高いことから、様々なやり込みができることで有名。動画サイトなどで『初期レベルクリア』や『ジョブ縛りクリア』など多彩なやり込みが公開されていて見ることができる。全くもって便利な世の中になったものである。
blocks.translation: As described above, it is famous for offering a great deal of freedom in tactics and allowing for all kinds of challenge runs. Videos of varied challenges, such as “starting-level clears” and “job-restricted clears,” have been posted on video sites and can be watched. The modern world has certainly become convenient.

blocks.source: 後半は一部の武器やアビリティが非常に強く、味方が強くなりすぎる。それにも関わらず後半のボスは弱い相手が多く、バランスは崩れ気味。
blocks.translation: In the latter half, some weapons and abilities become extremely powerful, making the party too strong. Despite this, many of the later bosses are weak, so the balance feels somewhat broken.

blocks.source: とはいえ、難易度自体はＦＦシリーズの中では安定している方だと思う。ラスボスなど強いボスも多いが、他のシリーズ作品と比較すると、極端な壁ボス・壁ダンジョンが存在しないので、初心者でも最後まで大きく詰まることなくクリアしやすい。
blocks.translation: That said, I think the difficulty itself is among the more consistent in the FF series. There are many strong bosses, including the final boss, but compared with other games in the series, there are no extremely difficult wall bosses or dungeons, making it easy even for beginners to clear the game without getting seriously stuck before the end.

blocks.source: 【快適性】
blocks.translation: [Comfort]

blocks.source: 戦闘テンポの速さはＦＦシリーズＮｏ１。（リメイクも含めば、ＦＦ１＆２の方が速い？）
blocks.translation: The battle pacing is the fastest in the FF series. (If remakes are included, are FF I and II faster?)

blocks.source: ダンジョン数はシリーズ作品でも最大級だが、シナリオ・システム共にテンポが非常に良いのでダルさを感じない。
blocks.translation: The number of dungeons is among the highest in the series, but both the scenario and systems move along at such a brisk pace that they never feel tedious.

blocks.source: ＦＦ３ではジョブを変更する度に一から装備をやり直さなければならなかったが、今回は持ち物の中から、自動的に最強装備してくれる機能があるので便利。ただし、呪われた武具を勝手に装備したりもするので一々調整するのが面倒。補助効果が重要なアクセサリまで、単純な性能で最強装備してしまうのはどうかと思う。とはいえ、当時は自動で最強装備するなんて便利機能がある作品の方が少なかったので贅沢な話ではある。
blocks.translation: In FFIII, you had to redo all your equipment from scratch every time you changed jobs, but this game has a convenient feature that automatically equips the strongest equipment from among your belongings. However, it may also equip cursed gear without permission, making it tedious to adjust everything each time. I question whether accessories whose support effects are important should also be selected as the strongest equipment based solely on their basic stats. Still, at the time, few games had such a convenient auto-equip-best feature, so this is a rather luxurious complaint.

blocks.source: 初期状態での歩行速度は遅めだが、シーフのアビリティ『ダッシュ』があれば速度が上昇する。しかし、そのためにはシーフを１人いれるか、貴重なアビリティ欄を１つ占有しなくてはならない。利便性を向上させようとするとダッシュが必須になるため、結果として遊びの幅を狭めてしまう。ダッシュのアビリティは無しにして。最初から、歩行速度を早くすべきだろう。
blocks.translation: The walking speed is somewhat slow at first, but it increases if you have the Thief ability “Dash.” However, this requires either keeping one Thief in the party or occupying one precious ability slot. Since Dash becomes essential when trying to improve convenience, it ultimately narrows the range of possible playstyles. They should have left out the Dash ability. The walking speed should have been faster from the start.

blocks.source: 【美術】
blocks.translation: [Art]

blocks.source: 敵キャラクターのドット絵がＦＦ４と比較して向上。ＦＦ４はザコ敵のグラフィックが今ひとつな印象があったが、今回はザコ敵・ボス敵共にデザインも良好だ。
blocks.translation: The enemy character pixel art is an improvement over FFIV. FFIV's generic enemy graphics left something to be desired, but in this game, both generic enemies and bosses have good designs.

blocks.source: ２２あるジョブ全てにおいて、キャラクター毎に異なるグラフィックを保有している。合計で１００以上もグラフィックがあるので華やか。最終的に全員すっぴんになるのがもったいない。
blocks.translation: All 22 jobs have different graphics for each character. With more than 100 graphics in total, it makes the game visually lively. It feels like a waste that everyone eventually ends up as a Freelancer.

blocks.source: 【音楽】
blocks.translation: [Music]

blocks.source: 曲の種類が多彩で質も高く聞いていても飽きにくい。「これがＲＰＧツクールの素材だったならば、非常に使いやすそうだ」とかツクール脳の僕は思ってみたり。
blocks.translation: The music is varied and high-quality, so it rarely grows tiresome even after repeated listening. My RPG Maker-minded self sometimes thinks, “If this were RPG Maker material, it would be incredibly easy to use.”

blocks.source: 印象に残る曲も多く、中でも『ビッグブリッヂの死闘』はＦＦシリーズでも屈指の人気曲。他にもメインテーマやフィールド曲など良曲揃い。船の墓場や古代図書館など、脇を締めるダンジョン曲も印象に残るものが多くスキが無い。
blocks.translation: There are many memorable songs, especially “The Battle on the Big Bridge,” one of the most popular songs in the FF series. There are also many excellent tracks, including the main theme and field music. The dungeon tracks, such as those for the Ship Graveyard and the Ancient Library, are also often memorable and leave no weak spots.

blocks.source: 僕の一押しはエクスデス戦。大ボスの威厳と格好良さを両立させた見事な戦闘曲だと思う。
blocks.translation: My top pick is the Exdeath battle theme. I think it is a superb battle track that combines the dignity and coolness befitting a major boss.
